title: Russian Mass Strikes on Kyiv, Kremenchuk, and Kryvyi Rih Kill 7, Injure 51
detail: Russian forces launched a large-scale combined strike on Kyiv, Kremenchuk (Poltava Oblast), and Kryvyi Rih (Dnipropetrovsk Oblast) overnight, using Onyx supersonic anti-ship missiles, Iskander-M and North Korean KN-23 ballistic missiles, S-400-launched projectiles, X-59/69 guided air-to-ground missiles, and 106 long-range attack drones including Shahed-type loitering munitions. At least 7 civilians were killed and 51 injured across Kyiv, Kremenchuk, Kryvyi Rih, and Donetsk, Kharkiv, Kherson, Zaporizhzhia, Sumy, Odesa, and Mykolaiv oblasts. The ArcelorMittal Kryvyi Rih steel plant — in President Zelensky's hometown — was struck directly, killing 2 employees/contractors and injuring 13. Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 85 of 106 drones and 3 of the guided missiles.

title: Ukraine Launches ~600-Drone Assault on Moscow, Penetrating Air Defenses
detail: Ukraine launched a major long-range drone assault targeting Moscow and the surrounding region, deploying around 600 drones in one of the largest single strikes of the war on the Russian capital. Russian authorities claimed to have destroyed 201 drones over the Moscow region, though Ukrainian drones bypassed part of the defensive screen, with at least 1 person killed and 3 wounded in the Moscow region. Analyst Pavel Felgenhauer described the attack as an escalation, noting Ukraine successfully penetrated some of Moscow's densest air-defense coverage.

title: NATO Spanish F-18 Shoots Down Russian Drone Over Romanian Airspace
detail: A Spanish F-18 fighter jet on NATO air-policing duty shot down a drone that breached Romanian airspace near Galati, about 24km north of the city, after it entered from Moldovan airspace. NATO military spokesman Martin O'Donnell said the drone "appears to be Russian." This marked the fourth such airspace-incursion incident involving Romania in 2026, underscoring rising friction between Russian long-range strikes on Ukraine and NATO's eastern-flank air policing.
